<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex88052023-10-044" status="finalized" ana="corpusmd:colophon"><rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:5302">tshad ma sde bdun kyi de kho na nyid bsdus pa</rs> | zhes bya ba | <rs type="deity">bde bar gshegs pa</rs>'i bstan pa lnga brgya' bdun pa la <lb n="21a2"/> bab pa'i tshe | me mo glang gi lo la | <rs type="place" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:5718">gte' ra bkra shis dbu mang gi dgon pa</rs>r | brtul zhugs kyi khur 'dzin cing | <choice><orig>rde</orig><sic>sde</sic></choice> snod rab 'byams la mang du thos pa'i shag kya'i dge slong | bla ma mkhas pa chen po <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4098">rdo rje dbang grags</rs><note type="gloss">dus rab bco lnga pa'i mi</note><note type="editorial">This note is by a different hand - likely modern - situates rDo rje dbang grags in the 15th century</note> kyis sbyar pa las |
               <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4099">shag kya'i dge bsnyen chos kyi bzhad pa</rs>s <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference">bla ma</rs> rngos las mang du thos te | lo shas tsam <lb n="21a3"/> lon pa'i tshe | <rs type="place" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:6060">g.yag rde</rs>'i <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4293">dge bshes thod pa bsod nams seng ge</rs>s gsol ba btab nas | cung zad bsdus pa la dga' ba rnams kyi don du sbyar ba'i | <rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:5302">tshad ma'i de kho na nyid bsdus ba'i nye bar bsdus pa</rs> | <rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:5302">ye shes <note type="gloss">shes bya ji lta ba dang ji snyed pa rtogs pas</note> ¦ rdo rje <note type="gloss">gzhan rgol ba <expan>thams cad</expan> tshar gcod pas</note> ¦ rin po che <note type="gloss">sangs rgyas pa'i grub mtha' dgos pa kun 'byung pas</note> </rs>¦ zhes bya ba ||
               <note type="gloss">2 zhus dag go</note> rdzogs s+ho |||| °°Ti ! || 
               
               <note type="translation">
                  The summary of the essence of the sevenfold collection of epistemology was composed by rDo rje dbang grags, the great learned Lama, the buddhism monk well-learned in the vast (three) baskets, holding the burden of vows, in the monastery of gTe’ ra bkra shis dbu mang, in the year of the fire-female-ox, in the 7th 500-year cycle of the teaching of the Sugata.
                  The abbridged summary of the Summary of the Essence of Epistemology – the precious vajra (of) wisdom (ye shes rdo rje rin po che) is completed.
                  It was composed for the sake of those who rejoice in what is somewhat summarized, by the upasaka Chos kyi bzhad pa, after  a few years had passed since thad listend profusely direcly from the Lama, having been requested by Thod pa bSod nams seng ge, the spiritual teacher of g.Yag rde.</note>
           </seg></TEI>
